display_long_description:
CLUB ROOM is a social VR experience where players meet, explore, and customize their own spaces inside a connected virtual reality.

At the center of CLUB ROOM is a shared building designed for social interaction:

Public Spaces
Join others in the Lobby, City, and Rooftop. Meet players and explore together in real time.

Private Apartments
Customize your own apartment using an in-app tablet to control lighting, doors, textures, and privacy.

Expandable Living
Unlock new environments including upgraded apartments and themed spaces.

Social Features
Add friends, manage requests, see who’s online, join others instantly, block users, and control access to your space.

Multiplayer Experience
Real-time multiplayer with voice chat. Interact naturally with others, move between spaces, and experience a shared world that stays active while users are present.

Media & Events
Watch videos together and create events in the Cinema.

Arcade & Mini-Games
Play built-in mini-games with more experiences added over time.

CLUB ROOM CONNECT
Stream content from your PC into VR in supported spaces, including the Cinema and Studio Cinema (purchasable).

Customization & Items
Collect and place items to personalize your space.

Economy
Players start with in-game currency and can purchase more to unlock items and spaces.

Third-Party Software Notices
